# Getting help with Lab Ledger Dental

- **Report a problem or ask a question** by opening an
  [issue](https://github.com/vladpereverzyev/lab-ledger-dental/issues). Say
  which version you use (shown in Settings and in the bottom right corner of
  the window), which system it runs on and what happened. Please do not attach
  real patient data or a backup of your archive.
- **For anything you would rather not post in public**, write to
  <info@vladpereverzyev.com>.
- A forgotten administrator password is reset with the recovery code from the
  sign-in screen.

The support page for app store users is at
<https://vladpereverzyev.github.io/lab-ledger-dental/support.html>.
